baselineDisplay.title: 远方来的漂流瓶
baselineDisplay.text:
第十七单元第一课【故事复现】远方来的漂流瓶 （上）
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: How did Jane receive a letter from a stranger?
问题：简是怎么收到陌生人的来信的？
• 词汇准备
• dream 做梦，梦想
• age 年龄
• Channel 海峡
• throw 扔，抛
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.
我的女儿简从未想过会接到荷兰一位同龄姑娘的来信。
Last year, we were travelling across the Channel and Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle. She threw the bottle into the sea.
去年，当我们横渡英吉利海峡时，简把写有她姓名和住址的一张纸条装进了一只瓶子，又将瓶子扔进了大海。
She never thought of it again, but ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland.
此后她就再没去想那只瓶子。但 10 个月以后，她收到了荷兰一位姑娘的来信。
Both girls write to each other regularly now. However, they have decided to use the post office.
现在这两位姑娘定期通信了。然而她们还是决定用邮局。
Letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster.
这样会稍微多花点钱，但肯定是快得多了。
第十七单元第二课【故事复现】远方来的漂流瓶 （下）
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 When did Jane travel cross the Channel?
2 What did she throw into the sea?
3 What did it contain?
4 What did she receive ten months later?
5 Do they write to each other regularly now or not?
6 Do they send their letters by post, or do they send them in bottles?
Answer: Jane crossed the Channel last year. She threw a bottle into the sea. It contained a piece of paper with her name and address on it. Ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland. They write to each other regularly now. They send their letters by post.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1. Jane never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl in Holland because _____.
(a) it is a long way away
(b) she has never been abroad
(c) no one in Holland knows her address
(d) she didn't expect anyone to find the bottle
2. Both girls _____.
(a) meet regularly now
(b) correspond in the normal way now
(c) send notes to each other in bottles
(d) travel regularly now
3. Jane never dreamed ____ a letter.
(a) to receive
(b) to receiving
(c) of receive
(d) that she would receive
4. She received a letter from a girl of her own age. The girl is ____ she is.
(a) the same age with
(b) the same age
(c) as old
(d) the same age as
5 Did she _____ the bottle into the sea?
(a) threw
(b) throw
(c) thrown
(d) throwing
6 She never thought ____ it again.
(a) for
(b) to
(c) at
(d) about
7. The girls write _____ regularly now.
(a) to one another
(b) the one to the other
(c) each to other
(d) to other
8 We were travelling across the Channel. We went on a _____ across the Channel.
(a) sail
(b) travel
(c) trip
(d) run
9 Jane wrote her name and address on a _____ of paper.
(a) lump
(b) bar
(c) tube
(d) sheet
10 Both girls often write to each other now. They write _____.
(a) frequently
(b) occasionally
(c) sometimes
(d) now and again
11 You can buy ______ at the post office.
(a) sweets
(b) stamps
(c) apples
(d) sugar
12 They will travel faster. They will travel ______.
(a) sooner
(b) more quickly
(c) hurriedly
(d) shorter
Key: 1 d 2 b 3 d 4 d 5 b 6 d 7 a 8 c 9 d 10 a 11 b 12 b
第十七单元 第三课 主动语态与被动语态的转换(中)
▶ 双宾语主动句的转换
含有双宾语的主动句在变为被动语态时，有以下四种情况:
▪ 有些双宾语动词在变为被动语态时，既可把间接宾语(指人)变为被动语态的主语，而把直接宾语(指事物)保留下来，称为保留宾语(Retained Object)；也可把直接宾语变为被动语态的主语，而把间接宾语改为介词 to 或 for 引起的状语(用 to 还是 for，与所搭配的动词有关)。
• He gave her some books.
→ She was given some books.
→ Some books were given to her. 他给她一些书。
• He bought her a watch.
→She was bought a watch.
→A watch was bought for her. 他给她买了一块表。
间接宾语前带介词 to 的有：bring，fetch，give，hand，leave，lend，offer，owe，pass，pay，post，promise，read，sell，send，show，take，teach，tell，throw，write 等;
带介词 for 的有：book，buy，call，choose，cook，do，fetch，find，get，keep，leave，save，make，sing 等。
▪ 带有双宾语的主动句，转换为被动语态时，通常只把表示人的宾语作主语。
• She asked me some questions.
→ I was asked some questions (by her).我被(她)问了一些问题。
• They denied me the chance of going to university.
他们剥夺了我上大学的机会。
→ I was denied the chance of going to university.
我被剥夺了上大学的机会。
带双宾语的动词有：ask，answer，charge，deny，envy，fine，refuse，save，spare 等。
▪ 主动句中的其中一个宾语为介词后的名词或代词
• 介词 of 后为直接宾语，转换时，通常以间接宾语作主语。
• They accused Tony of cheating on the exam. 他们指责托尼考试作弊。
→Tony was accused of cheating on the exam. 托尼被指责考试作弊。
• The police suspected him of giving false information.
警方怀疑他提供假情报。
→He was suspected of giving false information by the police.
他受到警方怀疑，怀疑他提供假情报。
• 介词 of 后为间接宾语，转换时，通常以直接宾语作主语。
• American teachers expect participation in the classroom of the student in many courses.
在许多课程中，美国教师期望学生参与课堂活动。
→Participation in the classroom is expected of the student in many courses.
在许多课程中，期望学生参与课堂活动。
• They asked favor of me. 他们请我帮个忙。
→ A favor was asked of me. 有人请我帮个忙。
注：与 of 搭配的这类动词有: accuse，assure，clear，convince，cure，demand，ease，expect，inform，relieve，require，rid，rob，strip（剥去), suspect，tell，warm 等。
▪ 直接宾语为 that 引导的从句，转换时通常以间接宾语作被动句的主语。
• The whistle warned visitors that the ship was ready to sail.
→Visitors were warned (by the whistle) that the ship was ready to sail.
汽笛通知旅客船即将起航。
• I can assure you that this information is absolutely reliable.
我可以保证这信息绝对可靠。
→ You can be assured that this information is absolutely reliable.
你可以放心，这信息绝对可靠。
▶ 复合宾语主动句的转换
将含有复合宾语的主动句变为被动语态时，应将宾语变为被动结构的主语，而宾语的补足语则留在原处成为主语补足语。
• He painted the door red yesterday. 他昨天把门漆成红色。
→ The door was painted red yesterday. 昨天门被漆成红色了。
• We refer to this kind of machine as computer. 我们把这种机器称为计算机。
→ This kind of machine is referred to as computer. 这种机器被称为计算机。
• The next morning people found the little girl lying in the corner dead.
翌日早晨人们发现那个小女孩躺在街角——死了。
→ The next morning the little girl was found lying in the corner dead.
翌日早晨有人发现那个小女孩躺在街角——死了。
注：使役动词 make，have 等，以及感官动词 see，watch，observe，feel，hear，listen to，look at 等，在主动语态中，接不定式作宾语补足语时，不定式前的 to 要省略;而变为被动语态时，成为主语补足语的不定式，则必须带 to。
• I saw him go into the general manager’s office.
我看见他走进了总经理办公室。
→He was seen to go into the general manager’s office.
有人看见他走进了总经理办公室。
注：作 let 宾语补足语的动词不定式，变为主语补足语时，动词不定式符号 to 可以省略，但只限于单音节词。
• They let the man go. 他们把那男子放了。
→ The man was let go. 有人把那男子放了。

在许多课程中，期望学生参与课堂活动。

• I can assure you that this information is absolutely reliable.

→ The door was painted red yesterday. 昨天门被漆成红色了。
• We refer to this kind of machine as a computer. 我们把这种机器称为计算机。
→ This kind of machine is referred to as a computer. 这种机器被称为计算机。
• The next morning people found the little girl lying in the corner dead.

blocks.text: 第十七单元第一课【故事复现】远方来的漂流瓶 （上）

• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。

Question: How did Jane receive a letter from a stranger?
问题：简是怎么收到陌生人的来信的？
• 词汇准备
• dream 做梦，梦想
• age 年龄
• Channel 海峡
• throw 扔，抛

• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。

My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.
我的女儿简从未想过会接到荷兰一位同龄姑娘的来信。

Last year, we were travelling across the Channel and Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle. She threw the bottle into the sea.
去年，当我们横渡英吉利海峡时，简把写有她姓名和住址的一张纸条装进了一只瓶子，又将瓶子扔进了大海。

She never thought of it again, but ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland.
此后她就再没去想那只瓶子。但 10 个月以后，她收到了荷兰一位姑娘的来信。

Both girls write to each other regularly now. However, they have decided to use the post office.
现在这两位姑娘定期通信了。然而她们还是决定用邮局。

Letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster.
这样会稍微多花点钱，但肯定是快得多了。
第十七单元第二课【故事复现】远方来的漂流瓶 （下）

• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 When did Jane travel across the Channel?
2 What did she throw into the sea?
3 What did it contain?
4 What did she receive ten months later?
5 Do they write to each other regularly now or not?
6 Do they send their letters by post, or do they send them in bottles?

Answer: Jane crossed the Channel last year. She threw a bottle into the sea. It contained a piece of paper with her name and address on it. Ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland. They write to each other regularly now. They send their letters by post.

• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。

1. Jane never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl in Holland because _____.
(a) it is a long way away
(b) she has never been abroad
(c) no one in Holland knows her address
(d) she didn't expect anyone to find the bottle

2. Both girls _____.
(a) meet regularly now
(b) correspond in the normal way now
(c) send notes to each other in bottles
(d) travel regularly now

3. Jane never dreamed ____ a letter.
(a) to receive
(b) to receiving
(c) of receive
(d) that she would receive

4. She received a letter from a girl of her own age. The girl is ____ she is.
(a) the same age with
(b) the same age
(c) as old
(d) the same age as

5 Did she _____ the bottle into the sea?
(a) threw
(b) throw
(c) thrown
(d) throwing

6 She never thought ____ it again.
(a) for
(b) to
(c) at
(d) about

7. The girls write _____ regularly now.
(a) to one another
(b) the one to the other
(c) each to other
(d) to other

8 We were travelling across the Channel. We went on a _____ across the Channel.
(a) sail
(b) travel
(c) trip
(d) run

9 Jane wrote her name and address on a _____ of paper.
(a) lump
(b) bar
(c) tube
(d) sheet

10 Both girls often write to each other now. They write _____.
(a) frequently
(b) occasionally
(c) sometimes
(d) now and again

11 You can buy ______ at the post office.
(a) sweets
(b) stamps
(c) apples
(d) sugar

12 They will travel faster. They will travel ______.
(a) sooner
(b) more quickly
(c) hurriedly
(d) shorter

第十七单元 第三课 主动语态与被动语态的转换(中)
▶ 双宾语主动句的转换
下面分别说明双宾语句及相关的“宾语 + 介词补语”“宾语 + 从句”结构怎样转换为被动语态：
▪ 有些双宾语动词在变为被动语态时，既可把间接宾语(指人)变为被动语态的主语，而把直接宾语(指事物)保留下来，称为保留宾语(Retained Object)；也可把直接宾语变为被动语态的主语，而把间接宾语改为介词 to 或 for 引起的状语(用 to 还是 for，与所搭配的动词有关)。

• He gave her some books.
→ She was given some books.
→ Some books were given to her. 他给她一些书。

• He bought her a watch.
→She was bought a watch.
→A watch was bought for her. 他给她买了一块表。
间接宾语前带介词 to 的有：bring，fetch，give，hand，leave，lend，offer，owe，pass，pay，post，promise，read，sell，send，show，take，teach，tell，throw，write 等;
带介词 for 的有：book，buy，call，choose，cook，do，fetch，find，get，keep，leave，save，make，sing 等。
▪ 有些双宾语句常把表示人的宾语用作被动句主语；具体能否采用另一种转换，要看动词、语境和表达习惯，不能一概说只能以人为主语。

• She asked me some questions.
→ I was asked some questions (by her).我被(她)问了一些问题。

• They denied me the chance of going to university.
他们剥夺了我上大学的机会。
→ I was denied the chance of going to university.
我被剥夺了上大学的机会。
这些例句分别使用 ask 和 deny；其他动词应结合各自的搭配判断，不能仅凭“双宾语”标签机械转换。
▪ 主动句中含宾语和 of 介词短语
• 在 accuse somebody of something、suspect somebody of something 等结构中，somebody 是动词宾语；转换时将它用作被动句主语，of 短语保留。of 后的成分是介词补语，不是动词的直接宾语。

• They accused Tony of cheating on the exam. 他们指责托尼考试作弊。
→Tony was accused of cheating on the exam. 托尼被指责考试作弊。

• The police suspected him of giving false information.
警方怀疑他提供假情报。
→He was suspected of giving false information by the police.
他受到警方怀疑，怀疑他提供假情报。
• 在 expect something of somebody、ask a favor of somebody 等结构中，something 或 a favor 是动词宾语，可以用作被动句主语；of 短语保留。

• American teachers expect participation in the classroom of the student in many courses.
在许多课程中，美国教师期望学生参与课堂活动。
→Participation in the classroom is expected of the student in many courses.
在许多课程中，期望学生参与课堂活动。

• They asked a favor of me. 他们请我帮个忙。
→ A favor was asked of me. 有人请我帮个忙。
注：与 of 搭配的这类动词有: accuse，assure，clear，convince，cure，demand，ease，expect，inform，relieve，require，rid，rob，strip（剥去), suspect，tell，warn 等。
▪ 在 warn somebody that…、assure somebody that… 等结构中，通常把表示人的宾语用作被动句主语，that 从句保留。

• The whistle warned visitors that the ship was ready to sail.
→Visitors were warned (by the whistle) that the ship was ready to sail.
汽笛通知旅客船即将起航。

• I can assure you that this information is absolutely reliable.
我可以保证这信息绝对可靠。
→ You can be assured that this information is absolutely reliable.
你可以放心，这信息绝对可靠。
▶ 复合宾语主动句的转换
将含有复合宾语的主动句变为被动语态时，应将宾语变为被动结构的主语，而宾语的补足语则留在原处成为主语补足语。

• He painted the door red yesterday. 他昨天把门漆成红色。
→ The door was painted red yesterday. 昨天门被漆成红色了。

• We refer to this kind of machine as a computer. 我们把这种机器称为计算机。
→ This kind of machine is referred to as a computer. 这种机器被称为计算机。

• The next morning people found the little girl lying in the corner dead.
翌日早晨人们发现那个小女孩躺在街角——死了。
→ The next morning the little girl was found lying in the corner dead.
翌日早晨有人发现那个小女孩躺在街角——死了。
注：make somebody do something 转为被动结构时用 be made to do something；see、hear 等动词的某些结构也可这样转换，如下例 be seen to go。不能把这一规则机械推广到所有使役或感官动词，尤其不能把 have somebody do something 直接改成 somebody was had to do something。

• I saw him go into the general manager’s office.
我看见他走进了总经理办公室。
→He was seen to go into the general manager’s office.
有人看见他走进了总经理办公室。
注：let 表示“允许”时，通常改用 be allowed to do something 表达被动含义。be let go 是“被放走、获释”等意思的固定用法，不能据此制定“单音节动词可省略 to”的普遍规则。

• They let the man go. 他们把那男子放了。
→ The man was let go. 有人把那男子放了。
